story.iWant: the daemon to manage free-agent sessions with a strict lifecycle — spawn on first message, enforce a per-session cost cap and idle TTL, reap on close or timeout
story.soThat: no runaway session can silently burn Anthropic credits or hold an EC2 process indefinitely while I'm away from my desk
story.tasks:
Infrastructure (SST): - Add FreeAgentSessionsTable (sst.aws.Dynamo) — PK sessionId, GSI1 operator-recent-index (operatorId, lastActivityAt), GSI2 scope-recent-index (scopeIdComposite, lastActivityAt), TTL on expiresAt, PITR enabled. Link to API Lambda. Add FREE_AGENT_SESSIONS_TABLE env var. Grant the daemon EC2 IAM role read/write on the table. (AC #9)
Shared types + schemas + repository: - Create functions/shared/types/free-agent.ts — FreeAgentSession, FreeAgentSessionStatus union (ACTIVE | PROCESSING | IDLE | EXPIRED | BUDGET_EXHAUSTED | ERROR), FreeAgentScope ({kind: 'project'|'plan'|'app'|'workspace', id?: string}), ModelAlias ('haiku' | 'sonnet' | 'opus'). (AC #8) - Create functions/shared/schemas/free-agent-schema.ts — zod schemas for session creation + message send + status enum. Use .safeParse() only. (AC #8) - Add `freeAgentSessions` to TABLE_NAMES registry in functions/shared/dynamo-client.ts. - Create functions/shared/repositories/free-agent-sessions-repository.ts exporting 13 functions: createSession, getSession, acquireProcessingLock, releaseProcessingLock, setClaudeSessionId, markIdle, markExpired, markBudgetExhausted, markError, incrementTurn, updateCostUsd, listAllSessions, listSessionsByOperator, listSessionsByScope. (AC #7, AC #8) - Create __tests__/free-agent-sessions-repository.test.ts covering all 13 functions, lock acquire/release success+conflict paths, GSI query shape assertions, TTL calculation. (AC #11)
Daemon — job handler: - Create daemon/pipelines/free-agent-session.mjs exporting runFreeAgentSession(job, ctx) implementing AC #2-7. Reuse runAgent-style spawn pattern (process.execPath + [CLAUDE_BIN, ...args] from agent-daemon.mjs:670+). Pipe credentials + FREE_AGENT_CONFINEMENT_ROOT via env. Parse stream-json output. Lock acquire (acquireProcessingLock), claudeSessionId capture on system.init, cost-cap exit detection (markBudgetExhausted), 600s SIGTERM-then-SIGKILL watchdog, error paths (markError). - Create __tests__/free-agent-session.test.mjs — first-turn + follow-up spawn args, claudeSessionId capture, cost-cap exit detection, watchdog, lock success/conflict, credential refresh, ensureWorktree call. (AC #11)
Daemon — wire-up: - Modify daemon/pipelines/job-router.mjs — JOB_HANDLER_FREE_AGENT_SESSION constant, selectHandler branch on 'free-agent-session', validateFreeAgentSessionJob. (AC #1) - Modify daemon/agent-daemon.mjs — dispatch case for JOB_HANDLER_FREE_AGENT_SESSION + GC scheduler ticker per AC #10 (lastFreeAgentGcAt + FREE_AGENT_GC_INTERVAL_MS = 24h, throttled-scan pattern after writeHeartbeat). The GC scheduler is the wiring deferred from Story 18.1. (AC #1, AC #10) - Extend daemon/pipelines/__tests__/job-router.test.mjs — handler-selection + validator assertions. (AC #11)
Validation: - Run `npm run ci` — verify zero new regressions beyond the known pre-existing failures from 18.1's CI run. (AC #12)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
AC #1 — JOB_HANDLER_FREE_AGENT_SESSION constant + selectHandler dispatch on jobType='free-agent-session' + validateFreeAgentSessionJob in daemon/pipelines/job-router.mjs. Payload shape: { jobType, sessionId, projectId, scope: {kind, id}, model, costCapUsd, credentials, messages }.
AC #2 — Job handler ensures worktree (Story 18.1 ensureWorktree), writes settings.json (writeFreeAgentSettings), spawns `claude -p <last-user-message> --model <model> --max-budget-usd <costCapUsd> --output-format stream-json --verbose --session-id <sessionId> --add-dir <worktreePath>` with cwd=worktreePath, AWS creds + FREE_AGENT_CONFINEMENT_ROOT in env.
AC #3 — Subsequent turns use `--resume <claudeSessionId>` (captured from first-turn system.init). Stream-json events forwarded to futurator-agent-events with prefix free-agent.turn.*. claudeSessionId persisted via setClaudeSessionId.
AC #4 — Idle TTL state machine driven by GC: ACTIVE + lastActivityAt > 30min → IDLE; IDLE + 2h further → EXPIRED; EXPIRED + 7d → worktree-eligible-for-reap (18.1 behavior). New message to EXPIRED session creates a fresh session record (forks); prior conversation persists in DDB.
AC #5 — Cost-cap exit detection: subprocess non-zero exit + last result event has is_error=true + message matches budget-related signal → markBudgetExhausted + persist costUsdAccumulated + emit free-agent.budget.exhausted event. API 402 response is Story 18.5's concern; this story implements daemon-side state transition.
AC #6 — Watchdog: 600s timeout (configurable via FREE_AGENT_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS env). SIGTERM first, 5s grace, SIGKILL second. Session → ERROR. Emits free-agent.turn.error with reason TIMEOUT.
AC #7 — acquireProcessingLock(sessionId): conditional UpdateCommand ACTIVE → PROCESSING. Returns {ok: true} or {ok: false, reason: 'SESSION_BUSY'|'NOT_FOUND'|'INVALID_STATE'} after re-fetch disambiguation. releaseProcessingLock(sessionId, newStatus) inverse transition.
AC #8 — free-agent-sessions-repository.ts exports 13 functions: createSession, getSession, acquireProcessingLock, releaseProcessingLock, setClaudeSessionId, markIdle, markExpired, markBudgetExhausted, markError, incrementTurn, updateCostUsd, listAllSessions, listSessionsByOperator, listSessionsByScope.
AC #9 — DDB table futurator-free-agent-sessions: PK sessionId; GSI1 operator-recent-index (operatorId, lastActivityAt); GSI2 scope-recent-index (scopeIdComposite, lastActivityAt); TTL on expiresAt (90d from createdAt); PAY_PER_REQUEST; PITR enabled.
AC #10 — GC scheduler from Story 18.1 wired into daemon poll loop via throttled-scan pattern (lastFreeAgentGcAt + FREE_AGENT_GC_INTERVAL_MS=24h). Now uses real listAllSessions from the new repository.
AC #11 — Unit tests pass: free-agent-sessions-repository.test.ts (all 13 functions + locking), free-agent-session.test.mjs (handler + 8 named subscenarios), extended job-router.test.mjs (dispatch + validator).
AC #12 — npm run ci passes end-to-end (no new regressions; pre-existing 4 epic-dev-pipeline failures + Plan.kind/TimerCategory typecheck errors unchanged).

doc.title: User memory — DynamoDB multi-table preference
doc.snippet: The new futurator-free-agent-sessions table is its own concern (the free agent's session lifecycle). Pipeline v1's agentSessionsTable/agentConversationsTable belong to a different active flow — do NOT reuse.

doc.title: User memory — ship MVP, add complexity later
doc.snippet: Don't build a per-session status-state-machine UI; the GC sweep IS the only mechanism that transitions sessions through IDLE/EXPIRED. Don't add a status-index GSI for GC performance optimization until table size demonstrates need.

The free-agent-session.mjs handler follows the same shape but additionally: passes session credentials via env, passes FREE_AGENT_CONFINEMENT_ROOT for the path hook, uses --max-budget-usd, uses --add-dir for the worktree, watchdog at 600s instead of 180s.

claude-code.component: Existing CLAUDE_BIN resolution + OAuth (--bypassPermissions not used). Flags this story uses: -p, --model, --max-budget-usd, --output-format stream-json, --verbose, --session-id, --resume, --add-dir, --append-system-prompt (optional).

story-context.constraints: - One table per concern — futurator-free-agent-sessions is dedicated to the free-agent runtime; do NOT extend Pipeline v1's agentSessionsTable. [Source: memory feedback_dynamodb_multi_table; Story 18.1 Completion Notes recon] - All zod validation via .safeParse() only — never .parse() at the boundary. [Source: CLAUDE.md Validation] - Credentials in the job payload are passed once; refresh logic lives in the API Lambda (Story 18.5). This story consumes credentials from the payload and pipes them into the CLI subprocess env. NEVER persist credentials in DDB or log them. [Source: Story 18.1 AC #2; daemon job-payload pattern] - The daemon's CLAUDE_BIN spawn pattern uses process.execPath + [CLAUDE_BIN, ...args] to avoid shell interpretation. Free-agent spawn MUST follow the same pattern. [Source: daemon/agent-daemon.mjs:670-730] - FREE_AGENT_CONFINEMENT_ROOT must be set in spawn env or the PreToolUse hook (Story 18.1) denies all Bash calls. The handler is responsible for setting it to the worktree path. [Source: Story 18.1 path-hook contract] - The new sessions table is referenced by NAME in the Story 18.1 IAM policy — creating the table here makes those permissions effective. No IAM policy changes required in this story. [Source: Story 18.1 sst.config.ts FreeAgentSessionRolePolicy] - Idle TTL state machine is GC-driven — no per-session timers. ACTIVE → IDLE @ 30min, IDLE → EXPIRED @ 2h, EXPIRED → worktree-reap-eligible @ 7d (existing 18.1 threshold). [Source: AC #4] - Watchdog: SIGTERM first, 5s grace, SIGKILL second. The Claude CLI's process group cleanup may need a moment; SIGKILL guarantees reap. [Source: AC #6] - Cost-cap exit shape from `--max-budget-usd` is not documented in the CLI help. Best-effort matcher: non-zero exit + is_error=true + message matches /budget.*exhausted|max.*budget|cost.*cap/i. Fallback: mark ERROR. [Source: AC #5; party-mode round 7] - GC scheduler uses the throttled-scan pattern from agent-daemon.mjs:3690-3692 (lastFreeAgentGcAt + 24h interval). Non-blocking call via .catch(log). [Source: AC #10] - API_BASE_URL stays relative in production (not applicable — no UI). [Source: CLAUDE.md Key Conventions] - Production-only SST deploy guard: any infra changes here only land on production deploys. Document this constraint in Completion Notes if relevant. [Source: CLAUDE.md Recent changes 2026-05-17 Decommission stale SST stages] - npm run ci must pass with zero warnings beyond the known pre-existing baseline (4 epic-dev-pipeline test failures + Plan.kind/TimerCategory typecheck errors). [Source: Story 18.1 CI summary]

interface.signature:
createSession(input: { sessionId, operatorId, projectId, scope, model, costCapUsd }): Promise<FreeAgentSession> — initial state ACTIVE, turnCount=0, lastActivityAt=now, expiresAt=now+90d
getSession(sessionId): Promise<FreeAgentSession | null>
acquireProcessingLock(sessionId): Promise<{ok: true} | {ok: false, reason: 'SESSION_BUSY'|'NOT_FOUND'|'INVALID_STATE'}> — conditional UpdateCommand ACTIVE → PROCESSING with re-fetch disambiguation
releaseProcessingLock(sessionId, newStatus: 'ACTIVE'|'ERROR'|'BUDGET_EXHAUSTED'|'IDLE'): Promise<void>
setClaudeSessionId(sessionId, claudeSessionId): Promise<void> — first-turn capture from system.init event
markIdle(sessionId): Promise<void> markExpired(sessionId): Promise<void> markBudgetExhausted(sessionId): Promise<void> markError(sessionId, reason: string): Promise<void> incrementTurn(sessionId): Promise<void> — turnCount++, lastActivityAt=now, lastTurnAt=now updateCostUsd(sessionId, costUsdDelta: number): Promise<void> — adds to costUsdAccumulated
listAllSessions(): Promise<FreeAgentSession[]> — full scan; bounded by 90d TTL listSessionsByOperator(operatorId, limit?): Promise<FreeAgentSession[]> — GSI1 query (Story 18.6 consumer) listSessionsByScope(scopeKind, scopeId, limit?): Promise<FreeAgentSession[]> — GSI2 query (Story 18.6 consumer)

tests.standards: Vitest with jsdom for shared/repos (functions/**/__tests__/*.test.ts). Daemon tests use vi.mock on child_process.spawn + fs + the Story 18.1 helpers (free-agent-worktree.mjs, free-agent-iam.ts) following the patterns established in daemon/pipelines/__tests__/party-bootstrap.test.mjs and party-turn.test.mjs. Repository tests use @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb DocumentClient mocks via aws-sdk-client-mock OR direct vi.mock of docClient.send. The conditional-update lock pattern tests must assert the ConditionExpression contents to verify atomicity (not just the happy path). Stream-json parsing tests construct controlled NDJSON sequences and feed them through the handler's stdout reader.

ideas.idea: job-router test — selectHandler({jobType: 'free-agent-session'}) returns JOB_HANDLER_FREE_AGENT_SESSION; validateFreeAgentSessionJob accepts a well-formed payload; rejects missing sessionId / missing credentials / missing messages with clear reason.

free-agent-session test — first-turn happy path: stub ensureWorktree, stub writeFreeAgentSettings, stub spawn returns a fake child emitting a single system.init event followed by text_delta + result events. Assert spawn args contain --model sonnet, --max-budget-usd, --output-format stream-json, --session-id, --add-dir, cwd=worktreePath, env has AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID + FREE_AGENT_CONFINEMENT_ROOT.

free-agent-session test — follow-up turn (turnCount=1, claudeSessionId set): spawn args include --resume and do NOT include --session-id. Assert claudeSessionId is NOT re-persisted (setClaudeSessionId called 0 times on N>0).

free-agent-session test — stream-json parsing: feed a sequence of {type:'system',subtype:'init',session_id:'xyz'} + {type:'message_delta'} + {type:'result'} lines and assert events emitted to pushEvent are correctly prefixed free-agent.turn.* with the sessionId as jobId equivalent.
repository test — markIdle and markExpired set the correct status; verify they only transition from compatible source states (ACTIVE → IDLE; IDLE → EXPIRED).

free-agent-session test — cost-cap exit: stub spawn that exits with code 1 AND last emitted line is {type:'result', is_error:true, error:{message:'budget exhausted'}}. Assert markBudgetExhausted called; free-agent.budget.exhausted event emitted; releaseProcessingLock called with newStatus='BUDGET_EXHAUSTED'.

free-agent-session test — watchdog: stub spawn returns a child that NEVER closes. Use fake timers (vi.useFakeTimers) to advance past 600s. Assert SIGTERM was sent, then SIGKILL 5s later. Assert markError called with reason='TIMEOUT'; free-agent.turn.error emitted.

repository test — acquireProcessingLock from ACTIVE: succeeds with {ok: true}. From PROCESSING: returns {ok: false, reason: 'SESSION_BUSY'}. From non-existent sessionId: returns {ok: false, reason: 'NOT_FOUND'}. From IDLE/EXPIRED/BUDGET_EXHAUSTED/ERROR: returns {ok: false, reason: 'INVALID_STATE'}.
repository test — releaseProcessingLock from PROCESSING to ACTIVE/ERROR/BUDGET_EXHAUSTED/IDLE succeeds; transition validity asserted via ConditionExpression in the test mock.
repository test — createSession populates all required fields (status=ACTIVE, turnCount=0, lastActivityAt=now, expiresAt=now+90d in seconds, scopeIdComposite formatted correctly).
repository test — incrementTurn atomically increments turnCount and updates lastActivityAt + lastTurnAt.
repository test — updateCostUsd uses ADD/SET expression atomically (not GetItem-then-PutItem race).
repository test — listSessionsByOperator queries GSI1 with operatorId; listSessionsByScope queries GSI2 with composite scope key; both return sorted-descending by lastActivityAt with limit honored.
SST integration check (manual or via sst-introspection script) — the FreeAgentSessionsTable has the exact PK + GSI1 + GSI2 + TTL configuration. No unit test for SST itself; assertion is via deploy.
daemon test (light) — the throttled-scan ticker fires runFreeAgentGc on the first iteration and not on the second within the 24h window. Use fake timers to advance 24h and assert second fire.
CI gate — full npm run ci. Verify no new failures beyond the known pre-existing baseline (4 epic-dev-pipeline failures + Plan.kind/TimerCategory typecheck + knip warnings).
